name: How long does a typical full home interior remodel take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical full home interior remodel take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a full home interior remodel varies significantly based on the scope, size of your home, and complexity of the changes. A small cosmetic update might take a few weeks, while a comprehensive gut renovation, including structural changes and multiple rooms, could take several months, often 3 to 6 months or more. Permitting processes, material availability, and unexpected discoveries can also influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule upfront.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full home interior remodel can take anywhere from a few weeks for cosmetic updates to several months for a comprehensive renovation, depending on scope.
